Name: Junimo Statues (CP)
Author: eorrl
Description:
Hey!

This is a mod for content patcher which changes the appearance of the Statue of Perfection, the Statue of Endless Fortune, and the Statue of True Perfection, so that they look like junimo statues in a variety of configurable colours! This mod should be unzipped directly into your Stardew Valley mods folder.

After launching the game, a config file will be generated. You can then set each statue ("Perfection", "EndlessFortune", and "TruePerfecton") to the following options:

Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Pink, Copper, Iron, Gold, Iridium, Vanilla

You can see each colour in the pictures above!

If you have Generic Mod Config Menu by spacechase0 installed, you could instead use that to configure this mod, without restarting the game.

This mod is also compatible with KeithmFrench's statue mods, including the Shrine of Fulmination, the Statue of Anglers Sorrow, and the Statue of Fortune! To change the appearance of these statues, download the optional files for whichever statues you're using, and unzip directly into your Stardew Valley mods folder. These statues can then be customized to any of the colour options above, using either the config file or spacechase0's Generic Mod Config Menu.

You can find KeithmFrench's statue mods here:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9133]Shrine of Fulmination[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9101]Statue of Anglers Sorrow[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9090]Statue of Fortune[/url]

Enjoy! :)

- Eorrl

Downloads.Description: Adds copper, iron, gold and iridium variants of the junimo statues, and fixes a slight inconsistency with the statues' shadows.
